notes.title: Infinitum 2025 Updates and Plans
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264256/020fb0c515d8511e0423af2e79d45880f69e960a.png[/img]
Hello everyone, I know it's been a while since the last update, but I am here to assure everyone that things have been moving faster than ever towards the better ending.

After the last free limited time demo and your feedback we have decided to take two steps back, add more content and remake some of the things done wrong. For this we needed to get a team, but without funding that seemed impossible, which is why we decided to partner with an investor that could fund that, and hire 3 more people to help us with things related to management, animation and development.

Today I would like to announce that we officially achieved that, and the work will start full time for everyone with the first month of the next year. We decided to start after the holidays are over so we can fully focus on developing the game efficiently, during this month we will also finish the planning and organizing we have left so we can smoothly move starting January. Because of all of this we have also just released a small patch with the following changes:

[list]
[*] Halloween props have been removed (finally).
[*] Dialogue System has been updated to not use the mouse cursor at all, you can now use the scroll wheel to navigate it, which will also help when we port the game for consoles.
[*] Added keys info inside of the dialogue system to be more beginner friendly.
[*] Added a few more changeable keybinds and we have also made a category system for those.
[*] Small UI changes, especially when hovering an interactable object.
[/list]

Please note many of the current bugs have not been fixed because we plan on redoing a lot of the things inside of the game, which include but are not limited to: Building and Crafting, Interaction, Dialogue, Flashlight and Batteries System as well as rebuilding some of the areas (merging the bunker and the Outpost into only one area to reduce confusion, the Outpost area will also be remade).

Since now we have a bigger team I would also like to mention a few of the things we will do starting with January:

[list]
[*] We will start being more consistent on all social medias, including youtube with devlogs every once in a while, but mainly you will see at least 2 posts every week on tiktok, instagram and twitter, with some exceptions.
[*] There will be a new alpha every month (on the last day of the month).
[*] Since we have a full time animator now, you can expect more high quality cutscenes and more realistic interactions between the players and Npcs.
[/list]

Each month we will have a major goal to complete, I will provide a roadmap for the whole year by the end of January. For January, we decided to fully remake the intro part of the story, as well as the NPC's and NPC's Dialogue system with the Outpost and Bunker as well. I also have a small surprise (which is actually big for the gameplay too) which will change how the main Character interacts with the world. It's a cool feature you don't see in any backrooms game and rarely in any games at all. ^^

In conclusion It's a huge step up for Infinitum, we have a team and funding now and we are ready to jump straight in. We will have weekly videos showcasing the game, and monthly updates and playable updates for all private testers! PS: The first playable version for the gamemode where you can play as an entity and eat your friends will come by the end of February March!

notes.title: Scream Fest Update Part 1
notes.content:
Welcome to part 1 of our Scream Fest Update! Here is what has changed from the previous version:

[b]DIALOGUE[/b]
Added Skip Dialogue Feature (both in replicated and non-replicated dialogues)
Fixed issue where mouse wouldn't disappear between player choices
Player camera now focuses NPC when initiating dialogue and speaking to the NPC

[b]OTHERS[/b]
Added Current status in lobby
You can toggle lights inside of the lobby by pressing on them
Re-added the Plague Doctor Limited Edition Skin Bundle to the game - for deluxe supporters
Added Two Slides Animations for the Slides inside of the poolrooms

[b]BUG FIXES:[/b]
Fixed Issue where you could pick up the same blueprint - which would cause blueprint replication inside of the crafting table
Fixed Issue where Clients couldn't turn on/off lights in Level -1 "The Infinite Graveyard"
Fixed Issue Where Copper was huge when deposited on a shelf - quite the funny bug
Fixed glitched subtitles for the intro cutscene
Fixed UI for Inviting Friends in Lobby when no friends were online
Multiplayer improvements

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264256/6ebc7741103333765248980480a24a35b93dbc20.png[/img]

     [h3]The following levels have been remade from scratch:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Level 2 "Pipe dreams"
[*] Level 33 "The infinite Mall" (performance should be improved)
[*] Please report any issues with any of these levels
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264256/0b163b31c2c6c3bcebec36e114114d178a39f731.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264256/28c0d795ceb03fc6a79de98d7c7462fef3dea7fd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264256/8909379cafde938115cae488a706ef8bb6e01459.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264256/67a9aace2f49c71214d854238299b76228d2a3a9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264256/08eaf3be0551e5fd73770f4b5181aae2f7672356.png[/img]

[h3]Loading screens and times[/h3]
[list]
[*] Saving and loading system has been fully remade from scratch, with the new multiplayer system which made us achieve shorter loading screens for both server and clients while fixing some replication issues as well
[*] Added a Loading screen before starting the game inside the lobby
[/list]

[h3]Slides[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added slides animations and a slides animation modular system, which will make slides animation possible everywhere in the future. Currently you can find the slide around in poolrooms and soon we will have them all across the levels as a way of traveling through areas
[*] Coming soon: Slide animations when traveling between levels
[/list]

[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*] New main menu song and main Infinitum Theme
[*] Footsteps system has been remade (footsteps sound correctly now from distance and sound changes accordingly if sound is behind a wall)
[*] Added sfx for placing a Colour Capsule inside a Colour Terminal
[*] Added sfx for going down the slide
[/list]

[h3]Multiplayer[/h3]
[list]
[*] A big addition to this new update is the way we handle multiplayer. Keeping things short, before this update the server was initiating and doing everything for the clients, which would take quite some time because it would have to update the variables(world data) every time before initiating an event. With this new update, we made it so that the variables update on each person playing, meaning that after joining someone's world, everyone has a temporary variable with the save stored up in their own game. When interacting with the world the game checks on each client's computer if he is able to give access to certain things instead of waiting for confirmations from the server.
[/list]

[h3]Crafting/Building[/h3]
[list]
[*] We are currently having some issues with crafting and building, so while some of the bugs were fixed we think there are more ways you can make this system glitch, so please let us kindly know about any of the issues you find 
[*] 
[/list]

[h3]Bugs Fixed:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Clients not being able to give Mr Kitty the cute item
[*] Mr Kitty appearing differently on each player
[*] Fixed Outside lights from level 974 not working for clients
[*] Fixed bug where stamina would decrease when jumping if you were crouched(the jump wouldn't happen in this case but you would lose stamina)
[*] Fixed bug where taking damage more than two times in less than a second would bug the PP effect on the screen
[*] Fixed bug where clients could not take the notebook from the Laboratory
[*] Fixed issues related to Colour Capsules not being able to be unlocked
[/list]

Note: Because of this update we had to redo most of code on how multiplayer is handled, which is why this update took so long to come out. In return for making people wait this long, we did our best with remaking some of the levels and adding a new level to the game while also fixing some of the main issues like the lights in Level 974. There still might be some multiplayer issues we overlooked, if found any, please let us know in the discord server and we will take care of all of them for the next update. Big thanks to all our supporters on Patreon and Ko-fi who made development along the months possible, you guys are the best.

notes.title: The Story Update
notes.content:
[h1]Infinitum Alpha 0.2.1 is now here![/h1]

[h3]Bunker[/h3]
-Added the Bunker, a structure which spawns in most levels and is part of the new saving system, your progress only saves when entering the bunker, think of this as a "safe room" and of course when doing any changes inside it (changing your bunker name or lights)
-Portal has been moved inside the Bunker and finding parts needed to start it now save (For example you can find Calum and put it inside the bunker and leave, next time when you come inside the bunker, Calum is still there)
-In order to build the portal, you need to find 27 servers which can be randomly found around the levels and the 3 Items (Calum, Henna and Solis)
-Introduced 7 Color capsules(Items) which can be found inside the levels and when put inside the bunker, you can customize the lights color inside the bunker
-The Bunker is planned to be a highly customizable place, currently you can customize the light colors and your bunker name, which is show on the walls

[h3]Story/Cutscenes[/h3]
-In order to build the portal you will need to find the 3 power sources and 27 servers which can be found randomly around the levels
-Introduced the intro part of the Story, proper cutscenes and the Infinitum Lab
-Introduced tutorial area with a proper tutorial for new players
-Cutscenes and tutorial area contain voice-lines and subtitles

[h3]Cats[/h3]
-Added cats to the game!
-1 cat can be found in each one of the 5 levels, so there are 5 different cats to be found
-Once a cat is found you can Adopt/tame it
-Adopted cats can be found inside the bunker
-In the future you will be able to add cosmetics to the cats and maybe take 1 cat with you and having a bonus, a 5% speed boost for example

[h3]InfoBook:[/h3]
-Updated levels, entities and exits with more details to help the player understand the game more

[h3]Entities:[/h3]
-Entities Ai, jumpscare animations and dead bodies left behind have been worked on and improved
New entity: Statues (something similar to Weeping Angels)
-can be found in poolrooms, they move at night and when the player is not looking at them.
-when getting too close during the night they will transform you into stone(with a proper animation which can be seen by other players)

[h3]Items:[/h3]
-New consuming sounds for a few items
-Added Pool keys(New item which can be used to open locked doors inside poolrooms)
-Item Icons appear now as sketches

[h3]Quests:[/h3]
-Added quests to the game, a free way of earning cosmetics/skins through progressing in the game/ finding things, you can consider these as side objectives to the story.
-There are currently 6 quests which offer 6 different Hazmat Suit Colors


[h3]New Feature: Levels travel Adaptation:[/h3]
-Traveling to a new level now adapts depending where you're coming from.
-As an example, if you take the escalators in Level 0 to get to Level 33, you will get spawned in Level 33 but behind you will be escalators which will take you back to Level 0 if you want to go back there again. Levels In Infinitum are not meant to be "completed", you are exploring a new world and the more you learn about it the faster you will be able to travel between these levels, completing your objectives and building your own story.
-This feature is not fully implemented yet but it has been implemented fully for the bunker (exiting a bunker will take you to the level you came from and next to you you will find the bunker)

[h3]Others:[/h3]
-Improved areas design where you can find the items needed to open the portal
-Introduced seamless travel, which should make traveling and loading times a lot faster and also fix all traveling between levels bugs
-When dying players drop their items now (before they would just disappear)"
-Everyone who participated in the Christmas event and placed well has now received their rewards
-Performance Improvements
-Screen popups now have sounds (notebook updated, achievement/quests completed)
-Added text chat and voice chat inside the lobby
-Added "Invite friends" feature inside lobbies
-World saves can now be played both as singleplayer and multiplayer
-Stamina system and hunger/thirst balance changes

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
-a TON of bug fixes ranging from ui and main menu to loading screens and generation, please report any bugs you find in the discord server

Planned features: Cats accessories and more animations, small building system inside the bunker to build shelves/crates to hold your items, and many more! These can be done only with the help of the kickstarter so if you enjoyed Infinitum just a little, have the possibility and would like to support this solo developer please consider suporting the kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/infinitumgame/infinitum-the-backrooms-story?ref=discovery

-Added Pool keys(New item which can be used to open locked doors inside poolrooms)
-Item Icons appear now as sketches
-Added quests to the game, a free way of earning cosmetics/skins through progressing in the game/ finding things, you can consider these as side objectives to the story.
-There are currently 6 quests which offer 6 different Hazmat Suit Colors
-Traveling to a new level now adapts depending where you're coming from.

-As an example, if you take the escalators in Level 0 to get to Level 33, you will get spawned in Level 33 but behind you will be escalators which will take you back to Level 0 if you want to go back there again. Levels In Infinitum are not meant to be "completed", you are exploring a new world and the more you learn about it the faster you will be able to travel between these levels, completing your objectives and building your own story.
-This feature is not fully implemented yet but it has been implemented fully for the bunker (exiting a bunker will take you to the level you came from and next to you you will find the bunker)
-Improved areas design where you can find the items needed to open the portal
-Introduced seamless travel, which should make traveling and loading times a lot faster and also fix all traveling between levels bugs
-When dying players drop their items now (before they would just disappear)
-Everyone who participated in the Christmas event and placed well has now received their rewards
-Performance Improvements
-Screen popups now have sounds (notebook updated, achievement/quests completed)
-Added text chat and voice chat inside the lobby
-Added "Invite friends" feature inside lobbies
-World saves can now be played both as singleplayer and multiplayer

[h1]Christmas Event 2023! [/h1]

Merry Christmas everyone! 
This year is the first Infinitum Christmas event, so here’s everything you need to know about it! 

In this event everyone will compete for exclusive Christmas cosmetics. This event only takes place In Level 37 "Poolrooms" only in normal and hardcore gamemodes.
You have to collect presents and then put these presents under a christmas tree. Each time you do this, you will receive +1 point to the global leaderboard.
Top 800, top 100, top 10 and top 1 will receive secret special exclusive cosmetics, which will never be available again!
There are 2 global leaderboards because of how steam does things. One category is the people who have a key for the game (aka the patreons), and the other one is the people playing the demo. So people who have keys will compete against people who have keys and people who play the demo will compete against people who play the demo.
Rewards will be saved for the full released of the game for people who decide to purchase the full version.
This event will be up until 27 December 20:00 GMT +1

notes.title: Infinitum: Pre Alpha 0.9.0 LEVEL 33 UPDATE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264256/e44e9b753d0e14b47515a52f37c48f2319e23db1.png[/img]
[h2]Infinitum Pre Alpha 0.9.0 Update! We are approaching the Demo Release on 20 December![/h2]

[h2]Patchnotes:[/h2]

[h3]Level 33 Is now here![/h3]

- Level 33 is an Infinite mall where the more you go in any direction the more this level decays and
looks more destroyed. Currently this level has 6 stages of decay, each one having a different
ambience which can be heard through the megaphones found around the mall
- You can enter this Level by finding the new room in level 0 with Escalators
- Added randomly locked doors
- Added Mall Keys item, you can find it in the shops around the spawn
- This level will contain the facelings, which will make their first appereance in the next update on 26 November

[h3]Inventory system remade from scratch![/h3]
- You can now Carry up to 16 items
- You can now carry up to 18 batteries
- New 3d UI for the Inventory, this inventory updates the character animations as well while using it

[b]The Customization System[/b] is now here along with the Halloween Event Rewards!
I previously mentioned that the 1st place will get a special Item and top 10 will get an exclusive witch hat cosmetic item, but because of the amount of people that joined this event, the top 1 will receive it's special item and top 50 people from the leaderboard will receive the witch hat

- Added text chat, you can now text with people while playing the game by pressing enter!
- The issue with the keybinds has been fixed now and you can change your keybinds in the settings menu
- The interaction system has been remade completely from scratch which will make adding new interactable items a lot easier!
- Lowered spawn rate for batteries and items but in return added more spawn points. This was changed in order to maximize the level generation randomization
- Added loading screen when opening the game which displays the current version you are playing and the game logo along with a main menu smooth tranzition
- Added screen pop up messages to the bottom of the screen when standing next to exits ( In the following updated I will make small additions like this to help new players understand the game faster )
- Added Almond Water texture

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Fixed a bug in multiplayer where interactable object would have no sound effects on clients
- Fixed but with infinite black screen when launching the game
- Fixed VHS overlay bad texture
+ Many smaller fixes

Please note that this update might have performance issues, bad textures, wrong models or anything that can be considered a glitch or a bug so I will be updating the game in the next few days with updates addressing these issues, please report any bug on the discord server specific forum.

[h1]Infinitum Pre Alpha 0.8.2: Halloween Update is here![/h1]

Added Halloween Event

[h3]Level 2 entity, "The Scratcher" remake:[/h3]

-The previous scratcher had many bugs and issues, especially in multiplayer. The new Scratcher features a new AI, a new model, a new jumpscare animation and a complex behaviour. 

-It can now hear sounds (walking, running and jumping can be heard, crouching behind him won't make him aggresive)

-The animation where the player gets killed has been updated, you can now see the Scratcher hit you which makes your mask jump off and the he bites your head two times.

-Updated the respawn screen

-Scratchers have 3 random skin variants: Normal, White and Nightmare

[h3]Added Creative mode![/h3]

-you can now travel between all levels at any given time with this gamemode. If you are playing the game using the creative gamemode, you will see a "creative" button inside your inventory. In this new UI you select any of the available levels to travel to.

[h3]Additional changes:[/h3]

-Added more random tips inside the loading screens

-Stamina drains now slower

-Hunger/Thirst bars now drain slower

-Added The following Event Item: Pumpkin

Level 33 will make it's first appearance next week. This level takes a lot of resources and time to make because the more you go in one direction the more the place gets destroyed. There will be a total of 6 stages of destruction. 

There will also be a new entity, and a custom random generation system where you can explore various random generated shops. This will be the best level to be added to Infinitum.

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]

-Fixed bug where players items wouldn't save between traveling levels in multiplayer

-Fixed Scratcher bugs

-Fixed bug where players could infinitely jump-Fixed bug where player would be able to climb tables and get inside walls

-Fixed bug where players could climb another player

-Fixed bug where Items would duplicate

-Fixed bug where flashlight battery menu wouldn't close when pressing Escape button

-Fixed key button displaying as "E" instead of "F" when Interacting with Items

-Fixed black screen after respawning in multiplayer

-Fixed generation bugs where the map would display walls differently across host and clients

+ Many more bug fixes

Some minor bugs with the event or scratcher are expected with this update so please leave them on the discord server so I can work on fixing them!

notes.title: INFINITUM Pre Alpha 0.7.2
notes.content:
[h3]Pre Alpha 0.7.2 update is here:[/h3]

[b]Level 37:[/b]
-Day night cycle is now on another level of complexity and it's fully developed
-Added Sun
-Added Moon
-Clouds are now updated and look a lot better
-Clouds changing shape and are moving every second
-Added Sun Shafts
-Added Moon Shafts
-Dawn and Dusk look absolutely amazing
-Day is now 7 minutes
-Night is now 3 minutes
-When entering Level 37, the time of the day is random
-Big fps boost! Around 5-15 fps with everything maxed out which is AMAZING
-Removed poolrooms tunnels places for a big remake
-Reworked all poolrooms rooms to be more "outside friendly", previously if you were to go outside it would look like you were not supposed to be there because of how the generation and level design looked, now everything should look more "outside friendly".

[b]Level 0:[/b]
-Changed carpet texture
-Made the walls pattern a little bigger

[b]Level Generation:[/b]
-The Level generation system has been completely replaced, the previous system had an issue I talked about where the map would spawn differently to players in multiplayer. [b]Developer Note:[/b] Next update will be released on 27 August. I will start working on the settings menu, which will contain fov change, sensitivity change, audio settings, more low-end and high-end users settings, keybinds and more. I will be adding a picture mode as well which will enable really high settings with the purpose of taking pictures. This month I have to  keep moving my computer between two places because I move a lot every week which slows down the development. I will also have to move to another country at the end of the month which slows things down again but it doesn't stop me from working on the game. Once I get to the new place I am moving too, I will be able to completely devote myself towards finishing the game again and development will skyrocket again, because I will be working 12-15 hours daily again.

notes.title: Pre Alpha 0.7.1 IS HERE! Complex batteries system, new UI and MORE!
notes.content:
[h2]Pre Alpha 0.7.1 update is here! New UI, complex flashlight batteries system AND MORE[/h2]

[b]General:[/b]
-Items now only get highlighted when you are hovering them with your crosshair
-Replaced the hud with a more simplistic and minimalistic one!
-Inventory UI was updated with a better one! The new one has a very simple and minimalistic style and it might be changed for the better in the future but I think something minimalistic and simple is what this game needs for now
-Updated Main Menu UI
-You can now carry up to 27 items!
-Added Batteries panel in inventory (Batteries are small so I made a different inventory for them because it wouldn't be fair for a battery to equal the space of a soda can for example)
-Each battery panel has its capacity displayed above the item picture
-You can carry up to 24 batteries at once
-Added eBook panel in inventory. This feature was not implemented yet but here you will be able to collect information about entities, etc in the future and also find leads to secret rooms, custom suits and easter eggs

[b]Level 0:[/b]
-The ceiling is now higher with 40 cm
-Added some new types of walls, there might be some generation bugs, please report those

[b]Items:[/b]
-The following items have been added to the game:
    -Batteries (5 types, all of them are the same but I added more textures for diversity)

[b]Level 974:[/b]
-To exit Level 974, you have to give the Teddy Bear to Mr. Kitty, this is pretty hard due to the fact he teleports pretty fast but achievable. Giving him the Teddy Bear, the door in the kitchen will open and you can take the slide which will take you to another level

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
-Fixed bug where there would still be light in Level 37 at night
-Fixed bug where you could no clip out of level 0 in Fast Food Area
-Fixed bug where you could climb Zena in poolrooms
-Fixed bug where wires would no clip through some places in level 37
-Fixed bug where cupboards were duplicated in Level 974
-Fixed some no clipping bugs and Foot placement in closets in Level 974

+ many other small tweaks and changes

Note: many bugs regarding batteries are expected so please test those out with the flashlight and try to glitch them and if you manage to do so please make a ticket and explain how to reproduce the bug so I can work towards fixing it

[i][u]Next Pre Alpha update is coming on the 6th August[/u][/i]

Link to patreon post: https://www.patreon.com/posts/86545855?pr=true
